cases.prompt: Use the error-taxonomy skill. Classify each raise site below with exactly one error kind from the skill's canonical set. Answer as a numbered list, one kind name per line, no explanations. (1) The caller passed limit=-5 to a paginated list endpoint. (2) The database connection was refused while handling a request. (3) A required environment variable is missing at service startup. (4) A defensive default branch over an already-validated enum was somehow reached. (5) A document update failed because another writer changed the document's version concurrently.
